source_mechanism: SWAP 4.3.1 derives relsatthr and ksatthr from the unmodified MvG law at the fixed nominal hthr=-2 cm.
With H_ENPR<0, watcon changes theta(h), so actual relsat reaches relsatthr at a different head.
hconduc gives the active KSATEXM branch precedence over the H_ENPR modified-MvG branch.
At activation the KSATEXM branch starts from the legacy unmodified-VG ksatthr rather than the one-sided H_ENPR branch conductivity at that actual head.
The resulting source-consistent K(h) therefore jumps downward in every frozen diagnostic case.
scientific_interpretation: The legacy H_ENPR<0 plus active KSATEXM combination is not a constitutively continuous composition for the tested default MvG family. This is independent of Ross table interpolation. A numerical solver cannot repair the physical branch mismatch without changing the requested constitutive model.

canonical_swap5_policy.legacy_reproduction: May be retained only through an explicitly named legacy-compatibility route if exact historical reproduction is required.
canonical_swap5_policy.replacement_route: Define a separate continuous near-saturation physical closure and expose it identically to FullRichards and RossFast.

scope_guard: The Staringreeks catalog defaults themselves have H_ENPR=0. The H_ENPR values here were imposed for combination diagnostics. This finding does not reject H_ENPR alone, KSATEXM alone, or a newly defined continuous physical closure.
